name: Debt Repayment Calculator
description: This calculator helps users determine how long it will take to pay off debts based on their payments and interest rates. Ideal for anyone looking to manage their debts effectively.
metaTitle: Debt Repayment Calculator | Free Online Tool
metaDescription: Plan your debt repayment easily. Free tool, no signup required!

faqs.question: What do I need to input?
faqs.answer: Enter your total debt, monthly payment, and interest rate.

faqs.question: Can I adjust my monthly payment?
faqs.answer: Yes, the calculator allows you to see how different payments affect your repayment timeline.

faqs.question: What is the benefit of this tool?
faqs.answer: It helps you visualize your debt payoff process and manage your finances better.
